name: Tyrande's Guidance raises Starfire Shot and Lunar Lance crit damage by 15% (#3071)
contract: Tyrande's Guidance 706572 (Spell.dbc, family 32) tooltip: "Increases the critical damage dealt by Starfire Shot and Lunar Lance by $s1%." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (15), EffectBasePoints 14 with DieSides 1 (=15), EffectSpellClassMask (0x800, 0x02000000, 0), matching Starfire Shot ranks and Starfire Barrage (word0 0x800) and Lunar Lance ranks (word1 0x02000000). Native path: Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus starts from crit_bonus = damage and, for SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_RANGED (both spells are DmgClass 3), adds another `damage` so a crit is 200%; with no other crit modifiers it subtracts `damage`, calls modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spell, SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, crit_bonus) on the bonus part only (1000), then adds `damage` back. So on the harness's fixed 1000 base a crit is 2000 without the talent and 1000 + 1000 * 1.15 = 2150 with it, a difference of 150, and both fixtures share race, class, level and gear so any other crit-damage term cancels. Scattered Star 804995 is outside the mask and must not change. Values read 2026-09-21 from the shipped /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Starfire Shot critical hit damage without the talent
Starfire Shot's critical bonus grows 15% (150 on the 1000 base)
Lunar Lance critical hit damage without the talent
Lunar Lance's critical bonus grows 15% (150 on the 1000 base)
Scattered Star critical hit damage without the talent
Scattered Star (outside the mask) crits unchanged
The crit bonus modifier is +15% on Starfire Barrage
